main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). Premier WA provincial circuit with excellent cambering. Features Western Australia's ONLY 1,000m straight course chute! On the main course, early speed ('E') and pocket pressers ('P') hold a slight advantage in 1200m sprints.
main_turf.post_bias: In 1000m straight chute sprints, barriers are exceptionally fair across the track. In 1200m sprints off the turn, inside stalls (1–5) hold a minor advantage.

scarpside_turf.bias_notes: The outer Scarpside circuit featuring the longest home straight in Western Australia (456m). Highly accommodating to closing swoopers ('S') and off-pace pressers ('P').
scarpside_turf.post_bias: Extremely fair course. Outside barriers are non-detrimental over 1300m to 1800m trips.

handicapping_angles.straight_1000m_chute_specialists: Upgrade horses with proven straight-track experience for 1000m straight races. True straight-line balance and sustained sectional speed excel without turns.
handicapping_angles.scarpside_456m_swooper_upgrade: When racing on the Scarpside course layout, upgrade strong late closers ('S' or 'P' types) who benefit from the grueling 456m home stretch.
handicapping_angles.perth_metro_shipper_class_edge: Pinjarra regularly hosts Perth Metropolitan alternate meetings. Top Perth yards (Adam Durrant, Neville Parnham, Grant & Alana Williams, Simon Miller) ship runners here. Upgrade horses dropping out of Ascot or Belmont Saturday metro company (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.pinjarra_cup_carnival: During the Pinjarra Cup ($150k+ Listed) & Magic Millions WA feature meeting, race class elevates to Listed/Group grade.
